entry: NO portal, ritual or first machine - the mod is live from the first tick. Body temperature is a third survival stat beside health and hunger: the ambient readout sits between the health and hunger bars, body temperature above the XP bar.

The correct OPENING quest is cold_sweat:thermometer (2 gold ingots + 3 redstone). Held in the hotbar or offhand it shows body temperature plus ambient; placed in an item frame it reads that spot. Three of four guides open with it.

The survival band runs -150 to +150; past +/-100 in either direction the player takes damage and dies. Before that, cold cuts max health, knockback, movement and mining speed; heat blurs vision, adds heat fog and sways the camera.
With Curios installed the thermometer can be worn as an amulet - relevant in this pack, which ships Curios.
boss_order: No bosses. The only added mob is the chameleon, passive and tameable.
order: 1. cold_sweat:thermometer first - see the numbers before anything else.

2. cold_sweat:waterskin (2 leather + 1 string makes two). A NEUTRAL waterskin does nothing - it must be heated or cooled before it is worth carrying. Filled and treated, it drips ~0.5 temperature per second from the hotbar and stacks across multiple waterskins.

3. The treatment pair: cold_sweat:boiler (cobblestone + planks tier; burns coal/charcoal/lava; heats up to 9 waterskins, 1 degree per 2s, max 120) and cold_sweat:icebox (burns snow/snowballs/clay/packed ice; cools at the same rate). Both hopper-automatable; a campfire heats and a soul campfire cools a waterskin with no machine at all.

4. cold_sweat:sewing_table - the mod's real answer to armor. Insulation items go onto ANY armor without losing enchantments: cold_sweat:goat_fur (cold), cold_sweat:hoglin_hide (hot), wool/leather (neutral, half strength), cold_sweat:chameleon_molt (adaptive, 75% strength, adjusts slowly). Shears pull insulation back off. Each piece has a fixed number of insulation slots shown in its tooltip.
5. The dedicated sets as an alternative: goat fur set (38 cold insulation, boots stop powder-snow sinking) and hoglin set (38 heat insulation, keeps piglins neutral, protects from magma blocks).

6. cold_sweat:hearth for the base - dual fuel (hot: coal/lava, cold: water/snow), redstone from the back emits warmth, from the sides chill, only works in an ENCLOSED roofed room, spreads ~96-block radius through non-solid blocks. Lava/water can be piped in; pair with cold_sweat:thermolith for a thermostat.

7. Nether kit: cold_sweat:soul_sprout (soul stalks on soul sand; farming it needs adjacent heat - the mod wants lava next to the soul sand) fuels cold_sweat:soulspring_lamp (heart of the sea + gold nugget + 2 iron ingots + chain), which holds the player just under the overheat threshold while in hand or offhand. Eating a sprout drops body temperature 20 for 45s.

8. Chameleon line: tame with a spider eye or raw fish (1-in-3 chance), it sheds cold_sweat:chameleon_molt once per day; molt makes chameleon scale armor and the thermolith. Fed biome-keyed food (dead bush/nether wart/cactus = hot, snowball/beetroot/sweet berries = cold, slime ball/ink sac/cocoa = humid) it points its tail at the nearest such biome for 5 minutes - a biome compass.
9. Late utility: cold_sweat:minecart_insulation (3 leather + 2 wool) -> cold_sweat:insulated_minecart, riders immune to temperature; ice resistance potions brewed from soul_sprout + awkward potion.
gates: The Nether is the wall this mod builds: without the soulspring lamp the heat is lethal, and the lamp needs a minecraft:heart_of_the_sea - ocean/buried-treasure loot gates Nether comfort.
cold_sweat:hearth does NOTHING outdoors or under open sky - enclosed room with a solid roof only. A quest hint should say so.
cold_sweat:chameleon_molt only comes from a LIVING chameleon shedding daily; killing one drops nothing.
Soul sprout farming is gated on heat placement: it only grows on soul sand with lava (specifically lava, not other hot blocks) beside it.
traps: The waterskin untreated is a no-op, and one guide flat-out calls the plain one 'a pretty useless item' next to a water bucket - quests should require the FILLED, heated/cooled use, not the bare craft.
Goat fur is a chicken-and-egg: goats live in exactly the icy biomes the fur armor is for, and they dodge shears constantly. Expect the trip to hurt.
Plain leather armor already insulates both ways (full set roughly triples endurance) - a cheap stopgap guides call out before any modded gear.
Neutral insulation is only 50% as strong as dedicated, adaptive 75% and slow to adjust - stacking wool is not equivalent to goat fur.
signature: cold_sweat:thermometer - the mod's face; first craft.
cold_sweat:waterskin with the cold_sweat:boiler / cold_sweat:icebox pair - the drink-your-temperature loop.
cold_sweat:sewing_table - insulate any armor, the item most quests should orbit.
cold_sweat:hearth (+ cold_sweat:smokestack on boiler/icebox) - base climate control.
cold_sweat:chameleon_molt - shed-only, adaptive insulation and the cold_sweat:thermolith (temperature -> redstone).
cold_sweat:insulated_minecart - the mod's one vehicle joke, riders exempt from weather.
